title: night
summary: A dark-time word, an armoured sound-alike and a distant Roman cousin.
question: Which clues belong to night’s family?
completion: Night follows Old English niht. German Nacht is a cousin; Latin nox is a more distant relative. Knight is a different word despite the matching sound.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
